:::{#exm-reducible-risk}
#### Reducible risk in the best-predictor exercise

In @exr-best-predictor,
the constant prediction function $\predfn_1$, with $\predfn_1\paren{\Predvar} = 3$, has reducible risk $5 - 1 = 4$,
and the prediction $\predfn_2\paren{\Predvar} = 4\Predvar$ has reducible risk $2 - 1 = 1$.

:::
